title: EzPearl
description: Allows you to use ender pearls without switching to them in the hotbar. Use the assigned button in the control settings.
body:
This mod allows you to easily throw your ender pearls without having to switch to them in your hotbar. If you're playing single-player or on local servers, you can simply have them in your inventory, not necessarily in your hotbar.

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a53ccb1e50a93f155c4c4526220d0e155bebd05f.gif)

### IMPORTANT:
If you plan to use this mod on servers, do so at your own risk! You also won't be able to throw ender pearls if they're **NOT** in your hotbar.
